description: For a U.S. town: how many businesses of one service (any town-page service: appliance_repair, dryer_vent_cleaning, used_appliances, hvac, plumbing, electrical, roofing, landscaping, cleaning, pest_control, locksmith, painting, garage_door, handyman, pool_spa, restoration, concrete_masonry, fence, gutters, septic, chimney, junk_removal, home_inspection, flooring, windows_doors, security_systems, remodeling, insulation, solar, well_drilling, towing, auto_repair, collision, diesel_truck, power_sports, welding, machine_shop, computer_repair, heavy_equipment, trucking) are within 25 miles, how many are verified (with the date checked), the brands they name most (appliance repair), and the list, verified first. Good for questions like "who fixes appliances in Covington, LA?" or "HVAC companies in Nashville, TN" when no ZIP is known.
